name: Jantje Willems — baptism and parents (1748 Groningen hint rejected)
researcher_question: When and where was Jantje Willems, wife of Jacob Jeltes and mother of Trijntje (baptized 1774) and Willemke (baptized 1777) in the city of Groningen, baptized, and who were her parents?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-3.csv row 17, hint-samples.csv row 591, flags adds_father/adds_mother/adds_christening, confidence 3). Resolved 2026-10-14 (#3338): false match, no substitute found. The 10 Nov 1748 Groningen baptism (ark:/61903/1:1:4G7B-5YMM, parents Willem Jans and Ikjen Jans) is very unlikely to be the subject: the 1772 banns with Jacob Jeltes (ark:/61903/1:1:H5TP-6GPZ, image ark:/61903/3:1:3QSQ-G9WL-2S47) call her the widow of Hindrik Harms Bos, whom she married in April/May 1764 (ark:/61903/1:1:H5T5-QW2M, ark:/61903/1:1:QLRY-B3VZ) at fifteen and a half if born in 1748. Avoid guards on the parents and the baptism plus a documented-negative finding; image_basis on, because the widow link exists only on the register page.
